name: onboarding-webapp

dependencies.name: user-auth
dependencies.description: Signs in HR Coordinators, IT Staff, and Facilities Staff via Thunder SSO.

description: Single-page app where HR Coordinators add new hires and manage the shared onboarding template, and each of HR, IT, and Facilities works from its own task queue and marks its own tasks complete. Calls onboarding-api for all data; holds no business logic or credentials of its own.
